conclusion: Decoded integer coordinates predict later exact floating corrections without transmitting a lookup table. Across the complete member, this saves 51267 bytes against the same-wrapper no-feedback control. Bounded integer intervals with Rice/raw fallbacks then reduce the result to 2159749 bytes. The interval rank saves 3365 bytes against fixed-bit coding and 92 bytes against uniform arithmetic using identical intervals. The major gain is structural prediction and numeric representation, not an information-theoretic advantage over arithmetic coding.
trial_notes: Earlier integer probes used an experimental frame identifier overlapping an image codec. The final three full candidates use the distinct CIXZ version-1 identifier and were re-encoded and independently restored; only these final artifacts are eligible for portfolio integration.
